list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'cnpg_backends_total' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] != '' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

targets.rawSql:
SELECT any(LogAttributes['db.query.text']) AS statement, count() AS calls,
       round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000, 2) AS p95_ms
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '$cluster' AND LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

defaults.noValue: Pick a statement on the Postgres fleet dashboard

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time,
       quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000 AS p50, quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['duration_us'])) / 1000 AS p95
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '$cluster' AND LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Plan

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, topK(1)(SpanName)[1] AS plan
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '$cluster' AND SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] = '$query_id'
  AND match(SpanName, '^\\w+( using \\S+)? on \\S+$') AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Most frequent scan node of the sampled executions in each interval.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TraceId AS trace, min(Timestamp) AS started, any(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name']) AS pod,
       round(max(Duration) / 1e6, 2) AS ms, anyIf(SpanName, match(SpanName, '^\\w+( using \\S+)? on \\S+$')) AS scan,
       TraceId IN (SELECT TraceId FROM otel.otel_traces WHERE ServiceName != 'PostgreSQL_Server' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)) AS from_app,
       toUnixTimestamp64Milli(min(Timestamp)) - 120000 AS from_ms, toUnixTimestamp64Milli(max(Timestamp)) + 120000 AS to_ms
FROM otel.otel_traces
WHERE ServiceName = 'PostgreSQL_Server' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '$cluster' AND SpanAttributes['query.query_id'] = '$query_id'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY TraceId ORDER BY started DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time,
       avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['rows'])) AS rows,
       avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['shared_blks_read'])) AS disk_blocks,
       avg(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cpu_user_time_us']) + toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['cpu_sys_time_us'])) / 1000 AS cpu_ms
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'pg_stat_ch' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '$cluster' AND LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT Timestamp AS time, SeverityText AS level, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
       toFloat64OrNull(extract(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), 'duration: ([0-9.]+) ms')) AS ms,
       substring(replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(Body, 'message'), '/\\*traceparent=.*?\\*/ ', ''), 1, 200) AS message
FROM otel.otel_logs
WHERE ServiceName = 'postgres-server-log' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = '$cluster' AND LogAttributes['query_id'] = '$query_id' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 100
